# Subway Seat for foot

Colors, dim colors, cursor, selection, search box, jump labels, URLs and the bell flash, in both a dark and a light section. Needs foot 1.26 or later, which replaced `[colors]` with `[colors-dark]` and `[colors-light]`.

[foot](https://codeberg.org/dnkl/foot) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/foot/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.ini`](subway-seat.ini) | `~/.config/foot/subway-seat.ini` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.ini`](subway-seat-tunnel.ini) | `~/.config/foot/subway-seat-tunnel.ini` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.ini`](subway-seat-enamel.ini) | `~/.config/foot/subway-seat-enamel.ini` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/subway-seat.ini
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/subway-seat-tunnel.ini
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/subway-seat-enamel.ini
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/foot/subway-seat.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/subway-seat-tunnel.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/subway-seat-enamel.ini`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
